name: COVIDcast Indicators
what_it_is: A collection of Python indicator pipelines that ingest heterogeneous COVID-19 data streams, compute aggregate signals at fine geographic granularity, and upload them to the COVIDcast Epidata API.
components: Shared utilities library (geo mapper, CSV exporter, validator, signal smoother, Slack notifier)
constraints: Each indicator installed/run independently; no monolithic entrypoint
Validation lag params must be tuned per signal
Weekly indicators use CDC epiweek format
notable_absences: No API server in this repo
